title: Tesla to open Semi Service Center in Laredo on Thursday, Nov. 12
excerpt: Tesla will open its Semi Service Center in Laredo with an invite-only celebration on Thursday, Nov. 12, from 4 to 7 p.m. at 13505 Regional Drive. Guests must RSVP by today, Nov. 10.
content:
Tesla will open a Semi Service Center in Laredo with an invite-only celebration on Thursday, Nov. 12, from 4 to 7 p.m. at 13505 Regional Drive, according to the company's official event listing. Guests must RSVP by today, Tuesday, Nov. 10.

The event will include site tours and ride-alongs, Tesla says, with parking available on a first-come, first-served basis and light refreshments provided. The company describes the celebration as a chance to see the growth of its Semi network.

The Semi is Tesla's electric Class 8 truck, and volume production began recently at the company's factory in Sparks, Nevada. A service center in Laredo puts maintenance on the I-35 corridor at the nation's busiest inland port, where thousands of trucks cross the border every day.

One detail remains open: the event listing does not say how many service bays the center will have, what its daily operating hours will be, or when regular customer service begins. A separate state filing with the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation lists a $1 million renovation of the 29,805-square-foot facility at the same address, with construction scheduled from Dec. 1, 2026, to Dec. 1, 2027. Tesla has not said publicly how that renovation relates to Thursday's opening celebration.

Charging is the other half of the picture. State filings list 11 Tesla Semi charging projects across Texas, including two in Laredo — at 13602 FM 1472 and 1011 Beltway Parkway — but none is confirmed open yet. Webb Watch will keep asking the questions that matter here: how many local jobs the center brings, when regular service starts, and what it means for the fleets that move freight through Laredo every day.

Sources: Tesla event listing (Tesla.com); TeslaNorth, Nov. 9, 2026; WhatNow San Antonio; AI Shift News (Texas TDLR filings).
